title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1514: Found you! (1)

section.p: Su Yu was quite interested in the residences on the eighth level, especially after learning that these were the residences of some big shots. However, he was more interested in the floor itself. Which part of Old Zhou was this floor located in?

According to his estimation, this should be Old Zhou’s legs. But legs weren’t supposed to look like this. Unless Old Zhou had been forced to remain in a split for eternity. If that was the case, the eighth level should be a rather long level.

Su Yu couldn’t help but wonder if Old Zhou would still be able to walk normally after remaining in a split for so many years. He couldn’t help considering the possibility of Old Zhou’s revival. After all, Old Zhou was too strong.
Even if Su Yu didn’t know who Tai Shan was, he couldn’t resist admitting that Tai Shan was truly ruthless and crazy. Killing someone was easy. But how much did he hate Old Zhou to do this instead?
Next, Su Yu returned his focus to the people present. Were there others on the eighth level? Teacher Liu and Hong Tan must have arrived some time ago. Why were they still stuck here?
As he sent his senses around, his tribulation character pulsed, notifying him of the power of laws filling the air.
The power of laws was heavy here.
“The power of laws.”
Su Yu considered himself someone familiar with the heavenly laws. He could see that there were some laws he shouldn’t challenge on the eighth level.
“Senior Lan Tian, kill the others. Don’t delay your search for Blood Fire. He should be quite heavily injured.”
Lan Tian said nothing. He merely smiled before vanishing with a flicker.
The old man from the Allheaven Treasure House hurriedly retreated while shouting, “Lan Tian, don’t be stupid! This is the ancient assembly! Fighting here will provoke the punishment of the laws!”
“Teehee, I’m not scared!”

Lan Tian merely giggled as a response. The old man felt extremely gloomy. He gnashed his teeth and sent random palm attacks out. Abruptly, a massive palm formed of heavenly laws descended from the sky. The old man had to teach Lan Tian that fighting here could easily result in death.
“This is only the outermost region of the eighth level, Lan Tian. Wake up!”

The massive hand dropped down with a power surpassing even the power of time. Curious, Lan Tian sent a palm attack toward the palm. With a rumble, Lan Tian took a step back with a slightly bloodied palm. As for the old man, he was smashed into the ground while coughing blood.
He knew that the laws were powerful. However, he had insisted on triggering them to keep Lan Tian in check.

“Lan Tian, this is the punishment for combat. The moment you start fighting to the death, the heavenly laws will react even more intensely. During the ancient past, this was where all the important individuals resided. No combat was permitted here. Thus, the laws here would punish such actions heavily…”
While coughing blood, the old man continued, “There is no grudge between us. Why harm yourself just to kill me?”
He had no choice but to do this when facing a lunatic like Lan Tian. A normal person would never do something like this, but Lan Tian was not normal.
Lan Tian giggled again and said, “That’s all? That’s not enough. It’s not enough to kill me. As for injuries…I’m not scared.”

More Lan Tians appeared around him out of thin air. Su Yu thought about it and asked himself a question. Since Lan Tian was someone with endless clones, what was the point of disguising himself as a shadow?

Thus, Su Yu transformed into a middle-aged man. Or to be precise, he assumed Zhao Ming’s appearance before joining the army of clones. It was impressive how Lan Tian could still produce so many clones even after losing so many.

The old man’s expression changed as he cursed before running deeper into the White Jade Avenue. How unlucky. He could only blame his luck for encountering a lunatic like this here. To escape Lan Tian’s clones, the old man was forced to toss out more than ten treasures. All of them were earth weapons. Evidently, he was very rich.
The old man traveled along the White Jade Avenue carefully as the power of laws was everywhere.

During the ancient past, this was the reception center. All visitors would be received by attendants, allowing them to travel to their destinations safely. But the eighth level had long been abandoned. Thus, they could only rely on themselves when traversing the eighth level.

After moving less than a hundred meters, the old man was stopped by the power of laws. Blood Fire Devil King had been able to move through this route safely earlier, but that was not the case for the old man.
The power of laws cut through his body, turning his flesh into mincemeat. The old man ignored his injuries and continued fleeing.

Mo Duona, Endless Passage, and the elder from the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion were uninterested in fighting a lunatic like Lan Tian as well. All of them started leaving. Their peace had been ruined by Lan Tian.

Meanwhile, the old man was starting to utilize the River of Time to flee, ignoring the power of laws descending upon his River of Time. He could only prioritize his escape for now. Suddenly, a middle-aged man closed in on the old man.
The old man did not react. He continued fleeing. Lan Tian was strong, but not strong enough to kill him with an attack or two. The old man was confident he could survive a few attacks from Lan Tian.
The middle-aged man, or Su Yu, to be precise, had an odd expression.
Was this a gift for him?
Sigh.
Why were the Pseudo Invincibles nowadays so careless? Sure, he had used his calm character on the old man, but the old man was still a Pseudo Invincible. What happened to his instincts?

Why was the old man leaving his back undefended? Su Yu was not one to give up on such a chance. He suddenly recalled that he had yet to punch anyone with his new strength. At that thought, he threw a punch out.
Heaven Suppressing Fist.

That was a technique of the multiple character faction. The moment the punch was thrown, the old man’s expression changed as all his hair stood on end. He screeched in desperation, “No! I know the way to unlock Bountiful Treasure General’s Residence!”
The punch landed, blasting the old man apart.
A River of Time appeared and a young man walked out of it. That was the younger version of the old man. He had a look of disbelief on his pale face. This was impossible. Lan Tian wasn’t this strong.

This had exceeded the level of a Pseudo Invincible. Right at that moment, a kick wrapped in the power of time descended upon him. With a rumble, the River of Time snapped and the young man was blasted apart again.

Almost at the same time, a book appeared and swallowed everything, including a carrier treasure. Blood essence, flesh, and everything about the old man had been collected by Su Yu. Before long, a new portrait appeared on the immortal page.

Su Yu raised his brow. So that was an immortal. It was rumored that the Allheaven Treasure House was related to the divines, devils, and immortals. That seemed to be the case here. An immortal had nearly escaped him.
A moon dropped from the sky.
Those who were in the process of leaving turned to stare at Su Yu blankly.
As for Su Yu, he nonchalantly picked up his book and calmed the power of laws rushing toward him. This was his punishment. One would be punished for killing here.

But Su Yu could see that the punishment was rather weak. It was only enough to kill Pseudo Invincibles. That was most likely because this was only the outermost region of the eighth level. The punishment here would not be sufficient to kill those at the Invincible Realm.
After blocking part of the power of laws, Su Yu allowed the big hand to grab him. A creak rang out while his body shone brightly. At that point, the hand ran out of power.
As the power of laws receded, Su Yu rubbed his arm and sighed, “How terrifying. It gave my arm a bruise.”
Silence descended.
Nobody said anything.
Endless Passage, the pavilion elder, and Mo Duona were all stunned.
Was this…really a normal person?
“Su Yu!”

Mo Duona exclaimed with shock before activating a talisman and vanishing. Not far away, space rippled as the laws stopped his teleportation. However, he was still able to move far away before reappearing with a flicker.
Su Yu was stunned. He said, “Why are you running? We’re partners.”
Far away, Mo Duona didn’t pause as he landed inside a large residence before vanishing with a flicker.
Bullshit!

Su Yu was too terrifying. Earlier, he was still relatively normal. He had to take a long time to kill even a Pseudo Invincible. But now, the freak had gained the ability to kill a Pseudo Invincible without breaking a sweat.
That was not all. Normal Pseudo Invincibles would normally suffer gravely from the punishment of the laws, but Su Yu had only suffered a bruise on his arm.

Mo Duona would no longer dare to call Su Yu his partner. For a partnership to work, there must be a balance. Such as their previous partnership. But now…would Su Yu still need to work with him after such a freakish growth?
Nope.
In that case, what else could he do but run?

Not far away, Endless Passage also activated his River of Time and risked provoking the laws to forcefully move himself away as well. The pavilion elder also roared as he summoned a boat before sailing away on a River of Time. Both of them were similarly shocked.
Holy shit!
Was this really Su Yu?
Was that really possible?
Killing a Pseudo Invincible like he was squashing a bug.
How terrifying.
Endless Passage was strong enough to fight Invincibles, but he also saw his own death from his River of Time. Yes. He saw his death in Su Yu’s hands. Thus, he fled without any hesitation.
That freak was too scary. He had to flee at all costs.

Behind them, Su Yu floated in the air with a gentle smile and fluttering robes as he said, “What’s the rush? I’m not killing you. I hope you can speak for me after leaving the mansion. I only killed about a thousand people. The rest were killed by Blood Fire…”
By that point, the two had gone far away. They only wanted to flee. Nothing else. They also realized that something major might have happened on the seventh level.

Su Yu…the freakish Su Yu had grown terrifyingly strong. They didn’t know how it happened. They knew that at such a young age, Su Yu had gained the ability to fight Invincibles. That was too terrifying.
People like Endless Passage had gained their strength after a long period of growth and accumulation. Sure enough, the human race was terrifying.
